summary.result: The overall results showed that the BPNN algorithm performed best followed by the MLR and GRNN in a statistical sense and this could contribute to provide valuable information to farmers, water managers and policy makers for effective agricultural water governance.
summary.background: The accurate estimation of reference crop evapotranspiration ( $ET_o$ ) is essential in irrigation water management to assess the time-dependent status of crop water use and irrigation scheduling.
summary.method: Artificial neural networks (ANNs) have been intensively implemented for process-based hydrologic modeling due to their superior performance using nonlinear modeling, pattern recognition, and classification.
